title: Spell out the trip first and the schedule gets sharper

basics.name: Trip name
basics.destinationPlaceholder: Search a city, e.g. Tokyo, Seoul, Bangkok
basics.destinationHelp: Cities in Japan, Korea and Thailand via Google Maps; you can still type freely if the service is off.
basics.dayCountAfter: — each day gets its own itinerary section once the trip is created.

travelers.title: Who is coming along?
travelers.help: Head counts feed the flight, stay and budget calculations later.

stay.title: Where do you like to stay?
stay.help: Leave anything you are unsure about blank; nothing gets filtered out by force.
stay.preferredAreaPlaceholder: No preference, e.g. Shinjuku, near a metro station

review.title: Route preferences and final check
review.help: Start from an AI draft, or from a blank plan with only flight, stay and meal cards.
review.aiDraftHelp: Approved places are laid out per day; everything stays editable.
review.manualBlankHelp: No AI call; routes are computed in one go after you order the places.
review.avoidRedEye: Avoid red-eye flights in later searches
review.notesPlaceholder: e.g. travelling with grandparents, no hotel hopping, a birthday dinner
review.aiNotice: Creating the trip sends the destination, dates, head count, preferences and notes to the AI provider configured by the site; no email, name or account identifiers are sent. The AI output is an editable draft — opening hours and bookings still need checking.
review.manualNotice: A blank manual plan never calls the AI. Only the daily flight, stay and meal cards are created; once you order the places, tap "Compute today's routes" for transit details.

summary.aiBody: Every day starts as an editable draft you can add to, lock or reschedule.
summary.manualBody: Only flight, stay and meal cards are kept; you add exact places day by day.
summary.routesAiBody: Once places are confirmed, each leg is planned by fewer transfers, fastest or less walking.
summary.routesManualBody: Compute routes once after ordering the day, so every new place does not call the map service.
summary.prefsBody: Travelers, budget, stay and interests are saved; you can let the AI re-plan later.
summary.pricing: The first AI draft, manual editing and routing are free; a real AI re-plan costs {ai}, applying a full-day route optimisation costs {optimization}, and the built-in fallback is never charged.

errors.datesRequired: Please choose start and end dates.
errors.startInPast: The start date cannot be in the past.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end date cannot be before the start date.
errors.tooLong: A trip can be at most 61 days.
errors.roomsExceedTravelers: Rooms cannot exceed the number of travelers.
errors.budgetPositive: The total budget must be greater than 0.
errors.nightlyInverted: The nightly minimum cannot exceed the maximum.
errors.createFailed: Could not create the trip. Please try again later.

gate.signInTitle: Sign in before creating a trip
gate.signInBody: Signing in lets us keep your travelers, budget, stay preferences and daily plan, so you never fill everything in only to lose it.
gate.unavailableTitle: We can't confirm your sign-in right now
gate.unavailableBody: The service is temporarily unavailable; please refresh in a moment. This is not treated as a sign-out.
